newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Oct 24:
NEW YORK - Norfolk Southern Corp. challenged CSX Corp. for the purchase of the northeastern railroad Conrail Inc., opening a multi-billion dollar bidding war.
WASHINGTON - Montgomery County, the Washington region's economic kingpin in the 1980s, is No. 2 behind Fairfax County in some key growth areas, according to a new survey.
WASHINGTON - AT&T names John Walker, chairman and chief executive of R.R. Donnelly and Sons Co., the world's largest commercial printer, as its new president.
WASHINGTON - A jury ordered the city's cable TV company, District Cablevision, to refund a total of $6.7 million to many of its subscribers as compensation for excessive late fees.
